assumptions.text: A1. Bicycle valve cores and stems are commonly manufactured in Taiwan and China; those jurisdictions are added for manufacture and export (common general knowledge).
A2. Expiry dates are priority date plus 20 years from the dates in prior-art/INDEX.md and are lower bounds only; filing dates, maintenance, adjustments and disclaimers have not been checked.
A3. The two requester-supplied intake references are stated to be fictional test documents and are used only as pointers to feature types.
A4. Laser cutting, shape-setting and electropolishing of NiTi tube are standard NiTi stent-industry operations with numerous process patents (common general knowledge).

open_questions.text: Q1. Which product configurations will be sold (replacement Presta core, OEM tubeless valve with proprietary stem, Schrader version, kit with sealant)? FTO scope follows the product.
Q2. Where will the seat ring be made, and does the NiTi supplier hold or license process patents that extend to non-medical parts?
Q3. Have the commercial clog-resistant tubeless valves marked 'patent-pending' in the search log been resolved to publication numbers?

Q4. Are the independent claims of index #1 (UTC Aerospace shape memory sealing ring) limited to a thermally actuated static seal? This decides whether the claim 67 seat ring sold as a component needs a design change or a licence.
Q5. Will counsel commission the professional FTO search before product launch rather than before filing?
